# unraid_rclone_remotes (Data Source)

Configured rclone remotes (name and type only; parameters contain credentials and are not read). Requires `READ_ANY` on `FLASH`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_rclone_remotes" "all" {}

output "remote_names" {
  value = [for r in data.unraid_rclone_remotes.all.remotes : r.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `remotes` (Attributes List) List of rclone remotes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remotes))

<a id="nestedatt--remotes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remotes`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Remote name.
- `type` (String) Backend type, e.g. `s3` or `drive`.
